scientific_integrity: Original source credited for blocking-neutrality and its monotonicity and Pareto inclusion theorems; existing complete four-person stable-roommates classification credited. New contribution is sharp conditional separation with the six-agent witness and adjacent reversal. Exact finite checker included.
scientific_limitations: Only perfect-pairing feasibility, complete strict lists and all partners acceptable; exact minimality over even sizes. The two six-person counts are for explicitly specified profiles; no all-six-person census, extension to singles, or independent audit claimed. Unindexed prior equivalence remains possible.
title: Six roommates first separate blocking-neutrality from Pareto efficiency in an unsolvable perfect market
